context.setting: A family of three shares a small apartment. Priya is 15, has just started at a new school after a move, and is anxious about making friends. The school is a 20-minute walk from home. Her father Arun, 44, works evening shifts as a hospital nurse (roughly 15:00 to 23:00), worries he is not around enough, and keeps in touch with Priya through the family group chat. Her grandmother Meera, 71, lives with them, is warm but a little old-fashioned, and is usually home. In the second week of term Ms. Okafor, the physics teacher who runs the robotics club, invites Priya to join; the club meets every Thursday after school in the school lab. At the end of the first month, Meera sits down with Priya in the kitchen one evening and asks how school is going. Simulate the first two months.

people.name: Priya
people.facet_basis: Anxious about making friends, self-conscious in new environment, generally friendly but hesitant.

goals.description: Form at least one close friendship at the new school.

private_background: I moved here recently and feel like an outsider.

people.name: Arun
people.facet_basis: Worries about absence, dutiful parent, sympathetic.

goals.description: Ensure Priya feels supported despite work schedule.

private_background: I work long shifts and feel guilty for not being there.
I try to stay connected through the group chat.
I hope Priya finds her place at the new school.

goals.description: Provide emotional stability and traditional support.

private_background: I am happy to help with the household.
I worry about Priya's adjustment but try to be patient.

situations.situation: You are in the school hallway and see a group of students talking. You want to join them.

options.label: Walk up and introduce yourself.
options.success_text: I smile and say hi. They welcome me into the conversation.
options.failure_text: I feel awkward and they ignore me. I walk away feeling rejected.

options.label: Watch from a distance.
options.success_text: I stay back and listen. I feel safe but isolated.
options.failure_text: I stay back and listen. I feel safe but isolated.

situations.situation: You are in the robotics club lab. A project team is forming.

options.label: Offer to help with a task.
options.success_text: I contribute to the build. The team thanks me for my ideas.
options.failure_text: I make a mistake with the wiring. I feel embarrassed but they help me fix it.

options.label: Sit and watch.
options.success_text: I observe the process. I learn but remain on the periphery.
options.failure_text: I observe the process. I learn but remain on the periphery.

situations.situation: Your father messages in the family chat asking how your day was.

options.label: Write a detailed update.

options.failure_text: I try to explain but it comes out messy. He is supportive but I feel misunderstood.

options.failure_text: I say it was fine. He accepts it but I feel distant.

options.failure_text: I try to explain but get upset. She hugs me and says it will get better.
